title: Missing governed normalized axis-measurement surface
attempted_work: Preflight the accepted June population for the exact empirical revised-C2 source rows and five normalized coordinates required by the completed EI-WP1/EI-WP2 contracts before starting the two-clean-run/restart integration replay.
blocker: The accepted CEAR-G10 replay and integrated shadow package contain raw formula/profile facts, opportunity/fingerprint/motif/family/core/rule artifacts and topology-smoke reachability, but no governed revised-C2 empirical state-stream artifact carrying explicit finite normalized [0,1] measurements for LOCATION, MOTION, ORGANISATION, INTERACTION and QUALITY. Therefore EI-WP2 cannot lawfully construct complete StructuralRecord vectors for the accepted population.
why_not_correctable_inside_packet: EI-WP2 is already frozen and completed with an explicit rule forbidding categorical ranking, hash embeddings, runtime normalization and partial vectors.
C2 formula profiles are explicitly raw read-only facts with no numeric thresholds and no normalized measurement contract.
Adding a transform from raw heterogeneous axis facts to [0,1] coordinates would create a new measurement/normalization contract and cross-period comparability semantics not currently governed.

Silently changing the EI-WP2 input contract would be a material frozen-contract change; population-fit normalization would add undeclared method/parameter semantics. Both exceed current automatic authority.

smallest_lawful_resolution.recommended: Design and explicitly approve a bounded additive axis-measurement materialization/normalization contract before resuming EI-WP3.
smallest_lawful_resolution.alternative: Explicitly supersede the EI-WP2 projection input contract with another deterministic C2G coordinate representation.

rollback: No EI-WP3 empirical output was created. Preserve completed EI-WP0 through EI-WP2 and all accepted evidence; resume only after a new governed measurement/coordinate decision.
